entities.name: Greta
entities.description: Human warrior of Eldraine based on Gretel, who became a witch hunter after her brother was eaten by a witch.

entities.name: Hanlon
entities.description: Greta's brother, eaten by a cannibalistic witch.

entities.name: Sweettooth Village
entities.description: Village of vicious sweet creatures where Greta and Hanlon were lured.

entities.name: Cannibalistic witch
entities.description: Witch who ate Hanlon and ran the candy-horror operation.

events.summary: As children, Greta and Hanlon are lured to Sweettooth Village; Greta escapes but Hanlon is eaten by a witch.
events.quote: Greta escaped, but her brother was eaten by a cannibalistic witch.

events.summary: Greta returns to storm Sweettooth Village, slaying candy horrors and rescuing a trapped boy.
events.quote: She rescued him, able to save someone who was trapped like she once was.

relations.quote: Greta and her brother Hanlon were lured to Sweettooth Village.

relations.note: Seeks vengeance on the witch behind the operation.
relations.quote: seeking vengeance on the witch behind the operation.
